{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=08|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018–19 North American winter]]
**[[Washington (state)|Washington]] Governor [[Jay Inslee]] declares a state of emergency as a [[winter storm]] that could bring up to {{convert|8|in|cm}} of snow begins to affect the state. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/snow-storm-wallops-pacific-northwest-people-rescued-sierra-nevada-n969681 (NBC News)]
*A fire at [[Clube de Regatas do Flamengo|Flamengo]] sports club's youth training camp in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], leaves ten people dead and three injured. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/08/football/flamengo-training-ground-fire-youth-team-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*A train collision near [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]], leaves one dead and 100 injured. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spain-1-dead-8-injured-in-train-crash-near-barcelona/2019/02/08/669e421c-2bd1-11e9-906e-9d55b6451eb4_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] 
;Law and crime
*[[2010–2017 Toronto serial homicides]]
**[[Bruce McArthur]] is sentenced to [[life imprisonment in Canada|life imprisonment]] for eight murders in Toronto, making him the oldest known sexually motivated serial killer in Canadian history. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/bruce-mcarthur-sentence-parole-eligibility-1.5009291 (CBC News)] [https://www.thestar.com/news/gta/2019/01/29/police-met-mcarthur-shortly-after-his-first-three-murders-his-age-may-have-helped-him-hide-in-plain-sight-experts-say.html (Toronto Star)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[Crisis in Venezuela]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**A senior [[White House]] official, speaking on condition of anonymity, reveals that the United States government is holding direct communications with members of [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|Venezuela's military]] urging them to abandon [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-military-exclusive/exclusive-u-s-in-direct-contact-with-venezuelan-military-urging-defections-source-idUSKCN1PX22L (Reuters)]
*[[Accession of Macedonia to NATO]]
**In a 153–140 vote, the [[Parliament of Greece]] ratifies the NATO accession protocol for [[North Macedonia]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/greek-parliament-ratifies-north-macedonia-nato-protocol/29758337.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis|Spanish constitutional crisis]] 
**The [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] announces that it is breaking off dialogue with the [[Generalitat de Catalunya|government of Catalonia]], escalating the regional crisis. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/spain-says-catalan-separatists-rejected-talks-needed-for-budget-idUSKCN1PX1Q0?il=0 (Reuters)] 
*[[2019 Thai general election]]
**[[Thai people|Thai]] [[Princess Ubolratana]] conveyed a message of thanks to Thais on Saturday morning after [[King of Thailand|King]] [[Vajiralongkorn]] issued a royal announcement late on Friday night saying political involvement by a senior royal is inappropriate.[https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/general/1626498/princess-ubolratana-says-thanks-to-thais (Bangkok Post)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
